params.description: Zero parameters; reads Host aliases from the local ~/.ssh/config

no_side_effect.note: Page URL identical before and after the call (file://.../index.html); window.zcode continuously available; readyState moving from interactive to complete is the page finishing its natural load, not a side effect of the call

notes: All 120 window.zcode methods are writable=false, configurable=false; method-level contextBridge wrap hooks are not feasible. Invocation is a direct Runtime.evaluate call of a window.zcode method, not hook interception. No model-list methods exist (getModels/listModels/getAvailableModels all absent); listSSHConfigAliases is the read-only array method with the clearest return shape and richest data.
